Topps Baseball came in two series. Series 1 has the first 241 cards. For the third year in a row, card 7 doesn't exist as it was retired in honor of Mickey Mantle. Series 2 runs from numbers 243 to 463.

Topps Baseball has a pair of die-cut inserts: Lords of the Diamond and Power Brokers. Both find their focus from featuring many of the game's best players at the time. Other basic inserts include All-Matrix, New Breed, Picture Perfect and Record Numbers. All-Topps Mystery Finest cards hide the featured player until a black cover is removed. Hall of Fame is a hobby-exclusive set that casts a player photo in front of their Cooperstown plaque.
